Project summary

Siddh Sai Corporation completed electrical cable fitting and street lighting projects for four state power utilities: GEB in Gujarat, MSEB in Maharashtra, RVUN in Rajasthan and MPPGCL in Madhya Pradesh. Utility work is held to strict technical and safety standards, and it is awarded only to contractors who meet them.
